Your new company   A Financial Services organisation requires a Level 2 IT Support Analyst for a permanent opportunity commencing ASAP, based in their Melbourne CBD office. The company promotes a collaborative and supportive work environment, offering exposure to leading technologies and ongoing career development opportunities. This role enables flexible working arrangements.     Your new role    In this exciting role, you will be: 
 
 Providing level 2 IT support to ~280 employees. 
 Performing technical support for cloud, servers, network and hardware. 
 Assisting with the delivery of infrastructure projects. 
 Acting as an escalation point for junior members of the IT team. 
 Contributing to cyber awareness training and managing internal phishing campaigns. 
 Maintaining and developing documentation and knowledge base articles. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed    To be successful in your application, you will need: 
 
 Prior experience in providing level 2 end-user IT support in a corporate setting. 
 Sound knowledge of Windows 10 / 11, Active Directory, Windows Server, Office 365, Intune / SCCM, AVD / Citrix, PowerShell scripting and Network troubleshooting. 
 Highly developed troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 A tertiary education in Information Technology, as well as Azure, Microsoft and ITIL certifications are beneficial. 
 Prior experience working in a Financial Services organisation is highly regarded. 
 
   What you'll get in return    Working in an organisation where they develop and grow careers, you will be offered an excellent salary package, in a role that offers exposure to leading technologies and projects. This organisation prides itself on internal promotion and career development and offers development training. Do not miss out! 
   What you need to do now    If you're interested in this role or know of someone that may be, please click 'Apply Now' or forward an updated CV to Daniel.Bertino@hays.com.au  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Lead mechanical capital projects from design to commissioning while enjoying a 5:2 roster   Your new company    Our client is a leading Australian resources organisation with a strong focus on operational excellence, innovation, and sustainable growth. With significant investment in asset upgrades and infrastructure improvements, they offer the opportunity to work on challenging and rewarding projects within a supportive and high-performing team. 
   Your new role    As a Mechanical Project Manager, you will be responsible for delivering a portfolio of mechanical capital projects from concept through to commissioning and handover. Working closely with engineering consultants, contractors, operations teams, and key stakeholders, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in line with business objectives. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Managing mechanical projects through all phases of the project life cycle 
 Coordinating consultants during scoping, study, and detailed design stages 
 Managing project schedules, budgets, risks, and reporting requirements 
 Overseeing contractor performance and ensuring contractual obligations are met 
 Leading project execution, construction activities, commissioning, and handover 
 Ensuring project documentation is maintained and complies with governance requirements 
 Collaborating with maintenance, operations, engineering, and site leadership teams 
 Monitoring project performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives 
 Ensuring all works are completed in accordance with safety, quality, and environmental standards 
 
   What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Demonstrated experience managing mechanical projects within mining, resources, heavy industry, manufacturing, or infrastructure environments 
 Proven experience managing consultants through early study and detailed design phases 
 Experience delivering projects through execution, construction, and commissioning 
 Strong understanding of project governance, project controls, and delivery documentation 
 Sound knowledge of contract administration and contractor management 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills 
 Ability to manage multiple project priorities in a fast-paced operational environment 
 Mechanical Engineering qualifications or a Mechanical Trade background will be highly regarded. 
 Commitment to maintaining high safety and operational standards 
 
   What you'll get in return  
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a leading mining operation and play a key role in the delivery of critical mechanical infrastructure and asset improvement projects. You'll enjoy a Monday-to-Thursday site-based roster with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays, camp accommodation provided, and the choice of FIFO or DIDO arrangements. Working within a collaborative and experienced project team, you'll have the opportunity to make a tangible impact while further developing your project management career in a dynamic mining environment. 
   What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. If you have any further questions, please call Jennah Murray 07 4960 1129. 
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.
result.title: Mechanical Project Manager

result.description: Advance Vision Technology   About the Role   As our business continues to expand, we are seeking an experienced ICT Business Analyst to join our Melbourne office and work closely with enterprise clients across a range of ICT projects involving business systems, software implementation, digital transformation and systems integration.  This is a senior consulting role responsible for analysing business operations, identifying technology opportunities, gathering and documenting business requirements, and working closely with stakeholders and software development teams to deliver high-quality ICT solutions.  The successful candidate will play a critical role throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and post-implementation support.   Benefits   What We Offer    Competitive remuneration package.   Long-term career opportunities with an established Australian ICT company.   Exposure to enterprise-level digital transformation projects.   Professional development and ongoing technical training.   Collaborative and supportive working environment.   Opportunity to work with clients across multiple industries.   International project exposure where required.     Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities   You will be responsible for:   Leading workshops with business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document business requirements.   Analysing existing business processes, workflows and enterprise systems to identify improvement opportunities.   Preparing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process maps and workflow documentation.   Performing gap analysis between business requirements and existing system capabilities, recommending practical ICT solutions.   Working closely with software architects, developers, testers and project managers to ensure business requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions.   Preparing process models, workflow diagrams, data flow diagrams and business rules using appropriate modelling tools.   Managing requirements traceability and assessing the impact of change requests throughout project delivery.   Supporting Agile, Scrum and Waterfall software development methodologies.   Coordinating System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management and solution validation.   Supporting enterprise software implementation, systems integration and digital transformation projects.   Facilitating communication between business users and technical teams throughout the SDLC.   Producing user documentation, training materials and conducting client training sessions.   Monitoring project progress, identifying project risks and assisting project managers in delivering successful outcomes.   Providing ongoing post-implementation business analysis and continuous improvement recommendations.   Supporting the company's Australian and international project teams when required.     Qualification & experience   Qualifications   Applicants should possess:   A relevant ICT qualification such as an Advanced Diploma, Diploma, Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline. Applicants with substantial industry experience in ICT Business Analysis may also be considered.  Relevant ICT industry certifications will be viewed favorably.    Skills & Experience   The successful applicant should demonstrate:   Minimum 5 years' professional experience as an ICT Business Analyst or Senior Business Analyst.   Strong experience working across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).   Extensive experience in business requirements elicitation, stakeholder management and business process analysis.   Proven experience preparing BRDs, FSDs, SRS documentation and user stories.   Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall methodologies.   Experience conducting workshops, solution analysis and requirements validation.   Strong understanding of enterprise software implementation and systems integration projects.   Experience coordinating SIT, UAT and production deployment activities.    Experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:   Banking or financial services systems   Payment platforms   Enterprise application integration   Digital transformation initiatives   Cloud-based business systems   ERP or CRM implementation projects    About Company     Company Profile   Advance Vision Technology (AVTech) is an Australian ICT solutions provider with more than 30 years of experience delivering innovative enterprise technology solutions across Australia and Asia. Our expertise spans enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, systems integration, cybersecurity, managed ICT services, business applications and digital transformation.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $110000-125000   Job Publish:  21-07-2026   Job Expire:  20-08-2026  Apply on:  ICT BUSINESS ANALYST Job here!    This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.
